import os, shutil
from tqdm import tqdm

src = '{{src_path}}'; dst = '{{dst_path}}'
size = os.path.getsize(src)
with open(src,'rb') as fi, open(dst,'wb') as fo, tqdm(total=size, unit='B', unit_scale=True) as bar:
    while True:
        chunk = fi.read(1<<20)
        if not chunk: break
        fo.write(chunk); bar.update(len(chunk))
